positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on Palantir's continuous delivery platform to more efficiently deploy and monitor software on the field.
Responsible for infrastructure that collects and ingests logs and metrics from all products across Palantir, enabling engineers and product owners to diagnose and monitor the health of their services in near real time.
Client and services all written in Go.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on Cortana's OAuth platform, which allows Cortana to integrate with third-party services on behalf of users. This includes everything from performing the initial sign in flow, to fetching and managing tokens, as well as making tokens available in throughout the stack. 

Also worked on features to enable third-party apps to be displayed and launched from within Cortana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working to migrate our intelligence platform into Azure and redesigning our UI to be more responsive and API driven (through knockout.js).
Breaking up our platform into independent components (think microservices), to help reduce friction in deployment and development.
Using the latest cloud technologies (like Azure DocumentDB, Search and Cache) to create awesome Web experiences.
